projects.name: The Loud Table
projects.org: The Loud Table, my marketing firm
projects.summary: The marketing and brand studio I founded and run.
sections: What it is
The Loud Table is my own marketing firm. I ask what a brand stands for, beneath what looks good in a deck.
How I work
I build on instinct already proven, ahead of promises still being tested. I sell trust you can leave alone, the kind that needs no checking up on.

projects.name: MTRX Digital
projects.org: MTRX Digital, a design and development studio
projects.summary: Co-founder of a studio building websites, apps, brand systems and automation.
sections: The studio
MTRX is a design and development studio creating websites, applications, brand systems, and practical automation. The name comes from Matrix: the systems beneath the surface.
The idea
Bring clarity, structure, and purpose to brands and products, as a response to overdesigned, underbuilt digital work.

projects.name: Stax Living
projects.role: Market research, creative direction, social media
projects.summary: A furniture campaign where the colour only arrives when you get home.
sections: The brief
Consistent social media posting, with themes and concepts for new furniture collections that use storytelling as a promotional tool.
The approach

Storytelling concepts built on human emotion. The day outside is black and white: the commute, the traffic, the noise of Bombay, routine without colour. Then you get home, and there is red. That is the furniture.
stats: Increase in enquiries for the collection

gallery.title: The campaign
gallery.note: Every frame stays grey until the furniture arrives.

projects.name: Indravansh
projects.org: Harshita, Founder of Indravansh Multi Designer Store
projects.summary: Turning a store’s founder into the face of her brand.
sections: The brief
The founder wanted to become the face of her brand, increase digital engagement, attract collaborations, and position the brand at the intersection of heritage and luxury.
The approach

We began by identifying the founder’s personal voice and visual sensibility, then built a content and presentation strategy around it, positioning her as the storyteller behind the brand rather than a separate marketing entity.
stats: Follower account collaboration, secured within 15 days

gallery.title: Three shoots a month
gallery.note: Heritage, detail, and the work behind every frame.

projects.name: DesignEcho
projects.org: DesignEcho Communications, a writing service based in Ahmedabad
projects.summary: Repositioning a writer as an editorial strategist.
sections: The brief
To develop brand guidelines that communicate a premium, luxury look and elevate the founder’s positioning from writer to editorial strategist.
The approach
A detailed questionnaire covering goals, service details, styling preferences, and references, followed by logo development and full brand positioning.
What came of it
A premium, cohesive brand identity that repositioned DesignEcho as an editorial strategy consultancy rather than a freelance writing service.

projects.name: Finance Solutions
projects.org: Finance Solutions, a finance consultancy based in Ahmedabad
projects.summary: Building a consultancy’s credibility through awards.
sections: The brief
Build credibility and visibility through award nominations.
The approach
Built a cold email list for relevant award nominations, drafted outreach emails and award forms, gathered the required data, and followed up where necessary.

projects.name: Women of Ahmedabad
projects.summary: Open conversations between women from every industry in the city.
sections: The idea
A community initiative bringing together women from every industry in the city. Four editions to date.
The approach
Independent speaker identification, outreach, and session structuring, followed by moderating each conversation. Sessions brought together women from unrelated fields for open conversation.
What came of it
Lasting professional connections between attendees and growing local recognition, including newspaper coverage.
projects.learned: Curating and moderating four editions built my ability to structure meaningful conversations, speak to a room, and adapt in real time.

projects.name: Mitti
projects.summary: Building a café’s events programme from the ground up.
sections: The role
Built Mitti’s experiential programming from the ground up, including the flagship initiative Women of Ahmedabad.
The approach

Conceptualized and hosted 4-5 events a month across formats: workshops, raves, screenings, lectures, community brunches. Handled artist management, outreach, and session structuring independently; oversaw execution on the day.
What came of it
Positioned Mitti as a recognized community space in Ahmedabad; sharpened leadership, communication, and adaptability through hands-on curation.

projects.name: Tech Kaushalya
projects.org: Tech Kaushalya, a large-scale university tech fest
projects.summary: Four years running every part of a university tech fest.
sections: The role
During my four years of university, I did everything and supervised every department, including promotions, sponsorships, social media, and on-ground operations.
The process
Chaotic. Every tiny detail matters and cannot be overlooked.
projects.learned: At that scale, one missed follow-up or overlooked logistic can stall the entire event. This lesson has carried into every initiative I have undertaken since.

projects.name: Trinity Preschool
projects.summary: Teaching, marketing, and the school’s first annual day.
sections: The role
Handled marketing, customer outreach, and teaching young children, and organized and hosted the school’s first annual function.
did: Organised and hosted the first annual function
projects.learned: Marketing for education demanded a different kind of empathy, since I was speaking to parents entrusting their child’s education to the school. It broadened my understanding of what good marketing can mean.

projects.name: On Stage
projects.summary: Hosting live stages, from TEDx to a startup programme.
sections: The stages
Executive Host at TEDx. Emcee for GUSEC’s HerStart Acceleration Programme 2025.
What it took
I learned to introduce spontaneity into a pre-written script while managing the nervousness that comes with live, unscripted moments.
projects.learned: It built my confidence and comfort speaking in unfamiliar situations, and shaped my continued interest in hosting and organizing events.

projects.org: A play staged at Tech Kaushalya
projects.summary: A play I wrote, directed and starred in.

sections: The play
I wrote, directed, and starred in this play during Tech Kaushalya.

It required me to organize scattered ideas into a coherent, engaging narrative and to communicate that vision clearly to the cast and crew.
projects.learned: A smoothly operating team matters more than individual talent.

about.statement: I think in stories before I think in strategy.
about.short: Give me a brand, a fest, a room full of five-year-olds, or a stage, and I’m doing the same thing every time: looking for what’s actually underneath it. People keep handing me the thing they can’t afford to get wrong, and trusting that once it’s mine, it’s handled.
paragraphs: Give me a brand, a fest, a room full of five-year-olds, or a stage, and I’m doing the same thing every time: looking for what’s actually underneath it, not settling for the obvious read.

I don’t wait around for permission or certainty. I move, and I figure it out as I go, whether that means chasing down a sponsor who’s already said no once, calming a room of children through their first annual day, or standing on a stage I wrote myself with no idea if the audience would laugh in the right places.

What ties all of it together isn’t a job title. It’s that people keep handing me the thing they can’t afford to get wrong, and trusting that once it’s mine, it’s handled. I’ve run departments, not just projects. I’ve built brands, not just posts.
And none of it happened alone. I’d rather build something with the right people around me than take credit for doing it by myself, because the work is always better that way.
